arguments.value: User wants help configuring reverse proxy/NAT to expose web servers on remote Raspberry Pis connected over OpenVPN through a QNAP NAS and public DNS/ports. Issue: public access via mydns:81 to NAS reverse proxy/port forward is not working, though VPN access to 10.0.8.10:80 works and ping between NAS and Pi works. They ask what routing/proxy/hostname changes are needed.
